subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Your School Library" answering the following questions.
stimulus: (a) How is your school library? (b) Where is it situated? (c) What kinds of books are there in your school library? (d) What is the use of your school library? (e) How can you borrow books from there? What is your feeling having such a library in your school?
